ERR_VM_ALLOC_EXHAUSTED.message: The program needs {requested} more bytes; {remaining} are left
ERR_VM_ALLOC_EXHAUSTED.hint: Make the program smaller: fewer or shorter variables.

ERR_VM_ACCESSOR_INDEX_FAILED.message: {id}: the position at step {chain_pos} could not be read

ERR_VM_OBJ_COPY_MISMATCH.message: A {src_type} of {src_size} bytes cannot be copied into a {dst_type} of {dst_size} bytes

ERR_VM_OBJ_COPY_SHAPE.message: The values do not have the same shape (element {index}, level {depth})

ERR_VM_OBJ_BAD_TYPE.message: {type} is not a type the board knows

ERR_VM_OBJ_BAD_SIZE.message: A {type} of {payload_size} bytes does not split into elements of {width}

ERR_VM_OBJ_NAME_TOO_LONG.message: A name of {len} bytes is too long

ERR_VM_OBJ_RETENTIVE_PTR.message: A {type} cannot be kept across restarts

ERR_VM_LOAD_BAD_STATE.message: The program upload is {state}; {expected} was expected

ERR_VM_LOAD_TOO_BIG.message: The program needs {requested} bytes; the board has {available}

ERR_VM_LOAD_DATA_RANGE.message: {id}: {len} values from {start_idx} do not fit its {items} elements

ERR_VM_ACC_BAD_KIND.message: {acc_id}: step {pos} is {kind}, which is not allowed there

ERR_VM_REG_OOB.message: {id} is outside the {count} {kind} of the program

ERR_VM_BLK_BAD_SHAPE.message: {blk_id} has {in_cnt} inputs and {q_cnt} outputs: not what its type takes

ERR_VM_BLK_BAD_REF.message: {slot} of {blk_id} refers to {ref_id}, which does not exist

ERR_VM_DYN_FULL.message: No room for more dynamic values (at most {limit})

ERR_VM_EXEC_BLOCK_HUNG.message: {block_idx} has run for {ms} ms without finishing
ERR_VM_EXEC_BLOCK_HUNG.hint: Check the block: a loop that never ends, or a device that does not answer.

ERR_VM_EXEC_SPAN_DEPTH.message: {block_idx}: loops are nested {depth} deep, too deep

ERR_VM_EXEC_BAD_SPAN.message: {block_idx}: its loop covers blocks {start} to {end}, which is not valid

ERR_VM_EVENT_OVERFLOW.message: Too many events from {source}: {dropped} dropped (queue of {depth})
ERR_VM_EVENT_OVERFLOW.hint: The source sends events faster than the program takes them: slow it down.

ERR_VM_EXPR_MATH.hint: Check the formula: a division by zero, or a value out of range.

ERR_VM_FOR_BAD_LOOP.message: {block_idx}: the loop would run {turns} times (at most {cap})

ERR_VM_OBJ_OWNERSHIP.message: A value is already placed elsewhere, would contain itself, or is nested too deep (at most {limit})

ERR_VM_OBJ_USR_PROTECTED.message: {obj_id} cannot be changed from the app
ERR_VM_OBJ_USR_PROTECTED.hint: Change it in the program, not from the app.

ERR_VM_LOAD_RUNNING.message: The program cannot be changed while it runs ({mode})

ERR_VM_EXEC_CONTROL.hint: Wait for the program to reach a state that allows it, or stop it first.

ERR_VM_OVERRIDE_PTR_UNSUPPORTED.message: {obj_id} is a folder: it cannot be written from the app

ERR_VM_OVERRIDE_BAD_RECORD.message: A write to {obj_id} is broken ({declared_len} bytes for elements of {item_size})

ERR_VM_EXEC_SELF_BARRIER.message: The program tried to stop itself from inside a block

ERR_VM_EXEC_FAULT_LATCHED.message: The program is stopped by a critical error of {device_id} ({root_tag}): acknowledge it to start again
ERR_VM_EXEC_FAULT_LATCHED.hint: Fix the device error, then acknowledge it and run again.

ERR_VM_PERIODIC_OVERRUN.hint: Give the block a longer period, or make what it runs shorter.

ERR_VM_RETAIN_UNNAMED.message: {obj_id} must have a name to be kept across restarts

ERR_VM_RETAIN_TOO_BIG.message: Keeping {obj_id} needs {need} bytes; at most {max} are kept
ERR_VM_RETAIN_TOO_BIG.hint: Keep fewer or smaller variables across restarts.

ERR_VM_RETAIN_MISMATCH.message: The kept value of {obj_id} does not match it ({type}, {size} bytes)

ERR_VM_RETAIN_CORRUPT.message: The kept values are damaged at byte {offset}

ERR_VM_SUB_TRACK_FULL.message: Too many values to watch (at most {max})

ERR_VM_BLK_OUTPUT_TAKEN.message: {slot} of {blk_id} writes {obj_id}, which another block already writes
ERR_VM_BLK_OUTPUT_TAKEN.hint: Let only one block write the variable.

ERR_VM_LOAD_ABORTED.message: The program upload was cancelled at {packet}: send it again from the start

ERR_VM_LOAD_INCOMPLETE.message: The program is incomplete: {id} was never loaded

ERR_VM_NO_MEM.message: No memory for the program ({size} bytes)

ERR_VM_BAD_ARG.message: A program request is not valid
